userStories.title: Dev reset — re-runnable onboarding (single-account test loop)
userStories.description: PRD W1·S10 (decision D9). Make onboarding re-runnable in ONE workspace so the operator tests with a single alias account instead of provisioning/deleting workspaces per attempt. (1) reset_onboarding(db, workspace, *, reset_trial=False, wipe_built=False, wipe_credentials=False) in orchestrator/services/onboarding_state.py: rewrite workspaces.onboarding to the initial doc via FULL JSONB reassignment (PRD-220-safe; match _write_trial's jsonb_set/whole-value style). This function is the ONLY sanctioned backward writer — do NOT loosen advance_onboarding_stage's monotonic/terminal validator. Preserve the trial object unless reset_trial; always stamp resets (incrementing int) + last_reset_at inside the doc. (2) reset_trial=True: strip the trial key, then re-grant via grant_trial_at_provisioning(db, workspace_id, owner_id=...) — REUSE, never a second grant implementation; a kill-switch/daily-cap decline is a reported pause in the response, not an error. (3) wipe_built=True: workspace-scoped deletion of what onboarding built — non-system agents (is_system_agent=False AND required_role != 'onboarding') + dependent rows, missions + orchestration tasks, agent reports/Deliverables, intake documents + workspace graphs, and the workspace's S3 document prefix — by REUSING services/workspace_purge.py machinery (_discover_scoped_tables / FK-safe ordering / _purge_s3_prefix) parameterized to spare survivors; NEVER a hand-maintained duplicate table list (two lists drift). The purge service's soft-deleted precondition, its workspace-row DELETE, its users DELETE, and its Clerk-user deletion must NOT apply on this path. (4) wipe_credentials=True: this workspace's credential rows only; the operator workspace (PLATFORM_KEY_WORKSPACE_ID) provably untouched. (5) Endpoint POST /api/workspaces/current/onboarding/reset on the EXISTING workspaces router (no new router file): gated on config.ONBOARDING_RESET_ENABLED (new config.py flag beside the TRIAL_* block ~:1309, default False, documented as TEMPORARY in .env.example) -> 404 when off (not 403 — don't advertise); workspace-admin auth in the same bucket as api/onboarding_agents.py's _require_admin; response returns counts of everything reset/wiped. Update the COMMITTED route manifest (orchestrator/reports/route-manifest.json — hand-add + count bump; test_route_manifest is the CI trap). (6) Frontend dev URL frontend/app/dev/reset-onboarding/page.tsx — unlinked from all nav: shows current stage + trial state (workspace provider), three switches (reset trial / wipe built / wipe credentials), RESET button -> endpoint, then clears tour/onboarding localStorage via the existing frontend/lib/shepherd/tour-storage.ts helpers (IMPORT them — modifying frontend/lib/shepherd/** violates the W2 scope guard), then redirects to chat. Renders a plain 'reset disabled' state on 404. Warns when wipe_credentials is on while reset_trial is off (converted workspace + no key falls through to unmetered platform resolution).
